fields.description: The ready-made look of the public website.

fields.label: Brand name
fields.description: Shown in the header of the site. If empty, the name set in Website Settings is used.

fields.label: Contact e-mail
fields.description: Shown on the Contact page and in the footer. Messages from the contact form are sent to this address. Use your own address: addresses at foss.ua are not accepted.

fields.label: Contact phone
fields.description: Shown on the Contact page and in the footer.

fields.label: Address
fields.description: Shown on the Contact page and in the footer, one line per row.

fields.label: Data controller name
fields.description: The full name of the person or company that is responsible for the data collected on the site. It is shown on the Privacy page; until you enter it, the page shows a reminder in square brackets.

fields.label: Contact form
fields.description: The contact form appears on the Contact page only when spam protection is switched on for your site and reCAPTCHA keys are available. Enter the keys for your own domain here (you can register it at google.com/recaptcha). On a site address that ends in erp-crm.org, the keys of the platform are used while these fields are empty. Until the form can work, the Contact page shows your e-mail and phone instead. The status below tells you why the form is not shown.

fields.label: reCAPTCHA site key
fields.description: The public key from your reCAPTCHA registration for this domain (Google calls it the site key).

fields.label: reCAPTCHA secret key
fields.description: The secret key of the same pair. It is stored safely and never shown again.

fields.label: Contact form status
fields.description: Whether the contact form is shown, and why not.

fields.label: Custom CSS
fields.description: For web designers. Your rules are checked as you type and again when you save. They apply to the public pages of the site only, on top of the chosen theme.

fields.label: Saved versions
fields.description: The last 20 saved looks. Restoring one saves it as a new version.

fields.label: Allow search engines
fields.description: Off: the site asks search engines such as Google not to list any of its pages, so it does not appear in search results. On: search engines may list the public pages.

fields.label: Colour and style overrides
fields.description: For advanced users. The values that differ from the chosen theme, written as text; the Custom theme editor fills them in for you. Example: {"tokens": {"color-primary": "#1d4ed8"}, "variants": {"card": "raised"}}.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Details for support. You do not need to change anything here.

fields.label: Notes on the Custom CSS
fields.description: Parts of your Custom CSS that this version of Website Kit no longer recognises.

fields.label: Notes on the standard pages
fields.description: Written when an update of Website Kit could not replace a page or a part of a page that you edited.

fields.label: Standard pages state
fields.description: What Website Kit last wrote into each standard page and page part. Used to tell your edits from the kit's version.
